title: Chinese Nourishing Stew
description: A hearty stew made with nourishing ingredients and a touch of Chinese flavor. Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, potatoes, and green beans

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they start to soften.
Add the tomatoes, nourishing broth, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
